notes.title: Early Access Polish – First Fixes In!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve started polishing up a few things that weren’t working quite right when Early Access began. Work is progressing steadily, and we're happy to share the following updates with you:

We fixed:

[list]
[*] The hand position when you pick up any of the base game ducks. This is an ongoing process, and eventually we want to fix it for all other ducks in the game.

[*] The ninja spot bug (if you know, you know).
[*] The hand position not resetting correctly.
[*] The Duck King spawn timer.
[*] The rim net, which is now visible.
[*] The ray interactors when you enter back into the intro scene from the game.
[*] The cruise ship floating over the sea.
[/list]

In addition to that, please be advised that we temporarily disabled the button to add any duck pack to a saved game (this needs some more reworking, and it'll be implemented in the future).

And that's all for today's patch note. We want to thank all of you who patiently reported any issues encountered.

Finally, we want to thank everyone who purchased the game and appreciates the ducks in VR. Your support throughout our journey is what allowed us to expand the game into the realm of virtual reality. You made this happen!

The ducks abide.
